Subject: Contract and capacity for upcoming renewal

Hi Rohan —

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. We're approaching our annual renewal in July and want to lock in terms and additional throughput for the fall spike. Attached is a short note with current utilization and the growth scenarios we've modeled (BlueWave_Renewal_Request.pdf).

High level asks:
- 12‑month term starting 2027-07-01 (we prefer keep pricing flat but are open to committed tiers)
- +25% guaranteed throughput during Oct–Dec window (burst capacity + predictable SLA)
- Clarify data retention and audit logs for SOC2 evidence retention (we'll need 13 months)

Can we schedule a kickoff next week to align stakeholders and draft a mutual action plan? Jordan (cc'd) will be the primary technical lead from our side.

Best,
Sara Kim
Head of Platform Partnerships
BlueWave Analytics

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Subject: Capacity options & cost delta (BlueWave renewal)

Sara / team —

Following up with the two capacity options we discussed on the kickoff. Summary below; full runbook is attached to the HubSpot record and the Drive link.

Option A (Conservative):
- Baseline commit = current average monthly tokens * 1.20
- Burst pool via pre-purchased credits (applies Oct–Dec) sized at 20% of projected peak
- Latency SLO: p95 < 380ms, failover to compatible quantized model for overflow
- Estimated annual cost delta vs status quo: +12%

Option B (Aggressive):
- Baseline commit = current average * 1.40
- Burst pool sized at 30% of peak with automated autoscale (short warmup using cached KV segments)
- Latency SLO: p95 < 320ms with reserved dedicated capacity during Oct–Dec
- Estimated annual cost delta vs status quo: +21%

Notes: both options include standard logging/audit retention and a 13‑month evidence package for SOC2 items. I attached a short checklist to the Drive folder: https://drive.company/BlueWave/QBR-Prep.

Next steps: Marissa to pick preferred commercial structure and we’ll convert to a term sheet for signature. Happy to run a 20‑minute technical deep-dive if the engineering team wants more detail.

— Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
